note: Copy to zones.json to use your own zones. Without zones.json, HR zones come from Strava and power zones are Coggan. heart_rate: lower bounds of Z1–Z5 in bpm, each entry valid from its date (optional). power: lower bounds of Z1–Z7 in % of FTP (these are the Coggan values – edit them, or leave power out for Coggan). Apply with npm run build.
